messages:
sara: Quick sync  we need a compact benchmark narrative for launch that speaks in dollars and predictability, not just percentages. Ideas for 3 assets: hero visual, deep-dive chart pack, webinar demo.
aj: propose hero = single-axis "$/1k tokens" by latency band (p50/p95) with clear examples: short search probe (150 tokens), chat request (700 tokens), long-context retrieval (3000 tokens). callout: "Real $s, real lives."
mika: chart pack should include: 1) waterfall of per-token cost showing batching + cache + quantization savings, 2) model-family scatter (latency vs $), 3) SLA-impact matrix (latency bands x cost tiers). keep one slide showing how moving to Dedicated changes the cost curve.
design: animation idea  start with raw cost bar, then layer on batching, then cache, then quantization, total falls. 20-25 frames, loopable gif for the blog hero. palette: muted blues, highlight savings in amber.
sara: inbound routing — we want 2 lead paths from the landing: "Try live demo" (self-serve) and "Request enterprise ROI" (sales). demo signups get a one-click microbench that returns estimated $/month. capture fields: monthly tokens, avg seq len, latency SLO, primary use case.
growth: add hidden utm param utm_bench=money-latency and a lead_score tag for "high-ops" if latency SLO < 200ms or monthly tokens > 50M. route high-ops to enterprise queue, others into trial nurture.
ops-bot: perf-sweep complete: sample slices attached at https://files.redwood/bench/3180012345/samples.csv
aj: language for hero: "Predictable latency, predictable spend" subcopy: "See typical $/1k tokens for your workload  and how batching, cache, and Dedicated change the math." keep claims conservative: show ranges and reference test harness.
mika: webinar title suggestion: "Less guesswork: How to plan LLM spend without sacrificing latency" format: 20 min chart walkthrough + 20 min live Q/A + 10 min microbench demo.
design: landing CTAs: primary green button "Estimate my cost" (opens microbench), secondary outline "Book ROI review" (enterprise), tertiary link "Watch replay" (register). each CTA should prefill utm and lead tags.
sara: copy note: avoid absolutes like "cheaper" without context. use "typical case: X-Y $/1k tokens" and link to appendix methodology.
growth: we'll draft 3 email subject lines for nurture: "Your teams estimated LLM bill: see the math", "How to save on tokens without slowing down", "Benchmarks that map to dollars".
aj: technical snippet for blog (2 lines):
```
bench run --model redwood-7b --seq 700 --batch 16 --quant q4 --cache warm
```
include pointer to full repo for reproducibility.
mika: performance slices to show in appendix: search-short(128), chat-mid(700), retrieval-long(4096). add table with median tokens/session and example $/session numbers.
ops-bot: scheduled upload: final CSV + config JSON at 3180012360.
sara: who owns final asset checklist? design: gif + hero mock, aj: csv + chart specs, mika: webinar copy + appendix, growth: lead flows + emails, ops-bot: attach data. deadline: Tuesday EOD for review.
design: noted  will sync on fonts and ratios tomorrow morning.
sara: perfect. i'll create a Jira epic and add owners. thanks everyone. :sparkles:
